edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns the initial owner address.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable, establishing access control.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner to call transferOwnership.
Parameter newOwner flows into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner gates the whitelist(address) administrative function.
onlyOwner gates the blacklist(address) administrative function.
Parameter address_ is used as the key written into the whitelist mapping.
Parameter address_ is deleted from the whitelist mapping.
Parameter address_ is read from the whitelist mapping in the view function.
whitelist() sets whitelist[address_] = true.
blacklist() deletes whitelist[address_].
enableWhitelist sets whitelistEnabled to true.
disableWhitelist sets whitelistEnabled to false.
whitelisted() reads whitelistEnabled to decide the return value.
msg.sender indexes the whitelist mapping in onlyWhitelisted and whitelisted().
onlyWhitelisted checks whitelistEnabled before allowing buyTokens.
Parameter endAt_ is stored into the endAt state variable in BaseICO.start.
start requires endAt_ > block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency check.
startAt is set to block.timestamp when the ICO starts.
personalCapEndAt is computed as block.timestamp + 48 hours.
touch sets endAt = block.timestamp when the hard cap is reached.
touch branches on block.timestamp to decide ICO completion.
buyTokens requires block.timestamp <= endAt and uses the personal cap window.
tune only applies endAt_ when greater than block.timestamp.
IonChainICO.start invokes super.start after its funding checks.
Parameter endAt_ is forwarded to the parent start function.
Local requireTokens is the threshold compared against balanceOf/allowance.
IonChainICO.start performs external token balanceOf and allowance calls.
The token state variable is the callee of the balanceOf/allowance checks.
hardCapWei feeds the requireTokens computation.
ETH_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_RATIO feeds the requireTokens computation.
ONE_TOKEN feeds the requireTokens computation.
buyTokens calls the external token.transferFrom before completing its final state updates (touch).
A malicious token contract invoked by transferFrom can re-enter buyTokens.
token is the external contract invoked by transferFrom.
tokenHolder is the from_ argument of token.transferFrom.
msg.sender is the to_ argument of token.transferFrom.
itokens is the value_ argument of token.transferFrom.
buyTokens computes the token amount with multiply/divide arithmetic.
amountWei is the arithmetic input for the token amount computation.
ETH_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_RATIO is used in the token amount multiplication.
collectedWei is incremented by amountWei.
buyTokens updates the per-investor purchase accumulator during the personal cap window.
msg.sender indexes the personalPurchases mapping.
personalPurchases[msg.sender] is accumulated and compared to the cap.
PERSONAL_CAP bounds the accumulated personal purchases.
buyTokens evaluates the native unchecked addition collectedWei + msg.value.
collectedWei is an operand of the unchecked addition.
buyTokens calls forwardFunds after transferring tokens.
forwardFunds executes teamWallet.transfer(msg.value).
teamWallet is the recipient of the forwarded funds.
The payable fallback function forwards direct payments to buyTokens.
Disabling the whitelist removes the onlyWhitelisted gate from buyTokens.
tune writes the endAt_ parameter into endAt when it is in the future.
tune writes the lowCapWei_ parameter into lowCapWei when non-zero.
tune writes the hardCapWei_ parameter into hardCapWei when non-zero.
tune writes the lowCapTxWei_ parameter into lowCapTxWei when non-zero.
tune writes the hardCapTxWei_ parameter into hardCapTxWei when non-zero.
start transitions the ICO state to Active.
suspend transitions the ICO state to Suspended.
terminate transitions the ICO state to Terminated.
resume transitions the ICO state back to Active.
touch transitions the ICO to Completed or NotCompleted.
Constructor parameter icoToken_ is cast and stored into the token state variable.
Constructor parameter teamWallet_ is stored into teamWallet.
Constructor parameter tokenHolder_ is stored into tokenHolder.
Constructor parameter lowCapWei_ is stored into lowCapWei.
Constructor parameter hardCapWei_ is stored into hardCapWei.
Constructor parameter lowCapTxWei_ is stored into lowCapTxWei.
Constructor parameter hardCapTxWei_ is stored into hardCapTxWei.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter whose only purpose is to feed the transferOwnership core function and owner state update.
address_ is a parameter consumed only by the whitelist core function.
address_ is a parameter consumed only by the blacklist core function.
address_ is a parameter consumed only by the whitelisted core view function.
endAt_ is a parameter consumed only by BaseICO.start.
endAt_ is a parameter consumed only by the tune core function.
lowCapWei_ is a parameter consumed only by the tune core function.
hardCapWei_ is a parameter consumed only by the tune core function.
lowCapTxWei_ is a parameter consumed only by the tune core function.
hardCapTxWei_ is a parameter consumed only by the tune core function.
endAt_ is a parameter consumed only by IonChainICO.start.
icoToken_ is a constructor parameter consumed only by the IonChainICO constructor.
teamWallet_ is a constructor parameter consumed only by the IonChainICO constructor.
tokenHolder_ is a constructor parameter consumed only by the IonChainICO constructor.
lowCapWei_ is a constructor parameter consumed only by the IonChainICO constructor.
hardCapWei_ is a constructor parameter consumed only by the IonChainICO constructor.
lowCapTxWei_ is a constructor parameter consumed only by the IonChainICO constructor.
hardCapTxWei_ is a constructor parameter consumed only by the IonChainICO constructor.
requireTokens is a local variable computed and consumed inside IonChainICO.start before the external token balance/allowance check.
amountWei is a local variable derived from msg.value inside buyTokens.
itokens is a local variable whose only consumer is the external token.transferFrom unsafe operation.
